items.title: Cambridgeshire County Council Highways: Winter Readiness & Road Infrastructure Plan
items.meetingTitle: Cambridgeshire County Council Highways & Transport Committee (28 July 2026)
items.content: Approved updated Highways Asset Management Strategy and winter readiness program. Priority gritting routes across Huntingdonshire and rural connector roads (including B1040) scheduled for pre-winter surface sealing.
items.summary: Approved updated Highways Asset Management Strategy and winter readiness program. Priority gritting routes across Huntingdonshire and rural connector roads scheduled for pre-winter surface sealing.

items.title: Parish Council Report: Highway Contractors Face Penalties for Poor Work & Flaxon Walk Bay Completed
items.content: From Parish Council Minutes: Cambridgeshire County Council confirmed highway maintenance contractors will face financial penalties for substandard repairs starting September. HDC confirmed completion of the Flaxon Walk disabled parking bay ahead of schedule.

items.title: County Council Reports £60m SEND Overspend; District Councillor Liaising on Newman Stores
items.content: From Parish Council Minutes: Cambridgeshire County Council reported a forecasted £60m overspend on SEND services (50% of service budget). HDC Cllr McIlwain confirmed ongoing discussions with the owner and planning department regarding the future of Newman Stores.

items.title: County Council Children & Young People Committee: SEND Provision & School Transport Update
items.meetingTitle: Cambridgeshire County Council Children & Young People Committee (14 July 2026)
items.content: Reported strategic review of Special Educational Needs & Disabilities (SEND) funding allocation. Includes improvements to rural home-to-school transport routes across Huntingdonshire.
items.summary: Reported strategic review of Special Educational Needs & Disabilities (SEND) funding allocation. Includes improvements to rural home-to-school transport routes across Huntingdonshire.
